BiblicalUsage: Ben-Hur means "son of whiteness." He was a man who was commissariat officer for Solomon in Mount Ephraim. You will find it in 1 Kings 4:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Ben-Hur is in Scripture for a reason, and no name there is an accident.
